summary: The PR addresses an issue related to Meta.ordering fields being included in the GROUP BY clause, but it introduces a new condition that may not cover all scenarios.

issues.description: The change only skips adding order_by fields to GROUP BY if default_ordering is not set. This might not handle cases where default_ordering is set but should not affect the GROUP BY clause.
Introducing a new condition could potentially break existing behavior where order_by fields are correctly handled in GROUP BY clauses.
